# Test fixtures

`thread-comments.json` is a **synthetic** Algolia HN `search` response for a
made-up "Who is hiring?" thread (story id `9000000`). Company names are
fictional; the header shapes mirror real posts seen in the November 2026 thread
(pipe headers, one-field-per-line headers, "Who wants to be hired" template
misposted as a job, a reply comment that must be excluded, region-restricted
and worldwide remote roles). No real posting text is stored here.
